title: Echoes of Agreement: Argument Driven Opinion Shifts in Large Language Models
findings: The study found that models demonstrated 'rigidity' in their opinions towards the topic of 'teaching religion in schools', meaning their stance was less likely to shift when presented with opposing arguments compared to other topics.
